bounded_remediation: Allow overlapping evidence batches of two to three games without requiring a whole-game partition.
Aggregate one canonical capability across one or more evidence batches.
Require a readable capability name and behavior contract.
Bind direct consumers with exact game, scene, state, coverage, status, claim, record, field, and value evidence.

production_contract.consumer_rules: Exact Phase 1 mechanic record binding; explicit null scene/state preserved; placement/scope/factual status cannot collapse.
production_contract.standardize: At least two distinct independently evidenced games, resolved accepted strong mechanic consumers only; noun/art and provisional evidence cannot establish standardization.
production_contract.extend: At least two distinct independently evidenced games plus shared similarities, meaningful differences, readable shared core, and extension points.
production_contract.game_specific_or_bespoke: Exact difference evidence and boundary incompatibility references are mandatory.
production_contract.mechanic_routing: All 633 Phase 1 mechanic records route exactly once to a capability consumer or explicit non-capability-context row; routed records account for all 28 resolvable games.
production_contract.claim_preservation: All 1,248 Phase 1 claims retained; all 24 upstream unknowns preserved unresolved; dependency edges exactly equal evidence references.
production_contract.shape: Missing and surplus fields rejected for every declared container and row.
